newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Bucherer has 89 pct of Bucherer AG certificates - CS.
newsitem.headline: Bucherer has 89 pct of Bucherer AG certificates - CS.

text.p: Holders of 11,697 Bucherer AG participation certificates (PC) have tendered them to Joerg Bucherer after his public offer, giving him 89 percent of the PC capital, Credit Suisse First Boston said.
Bucherer, who holds 100 percent of the company's share capital, offered 625 Swiss francs per PC on January 20. The offer expired on March 6. Pay date is March 19.
CSFB said 27,381 participation certificates remained in public ownership. They closed today at 635, up five.
